config.dwm.option.dimensionsBlacklist.@T: List of Dimensions that will not be displayed in the TARDIS Dimensions List.
config.dwm.option.hideTheEndConditionall: Hide The End from the TARDIS Dimensions List until the Dragon is defeated.
config.dwm.option.tardisRecallOperatorOn: Allow only operators to recall the TARDIS by key.
config.dwm.option.dimensionsAlwaysAvaila: Allows you to visit any dimension without having to visit them first.
Allows you to visit any biome without having to visit them first.
config.dwm.option.structuresAlwaysAvaila: Allows you to visit any structure without having to visit them first.
config.dwm.option.filterStructuresByVisi: Show structures only for biomes that have already been visited

Shows only structures of already visited biomes (if structuresAlwaysAvailable = false, the structure still needs to be visited separately. If structuresAlwaysAvailable = true, all structures related to visited biomes are immediately shown).
